text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! <chrname>! That was a sweeping 
victory, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Her adaptation to the turf was 
outstanding. Her tactical adaptability was 
beyond reproach as well!

Refusing to be outdone by the cheers 
pouring from the stands, Chairwoman 
Akikawa and I continued to shower <chrname> with 
praise for her performance.

Although the Prix Niel is a race only for 
Classic-class Umamusume, she should have 
demonstrated more than enough strength.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I can win.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: She can do it...! You can win this, <chrname>...!!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—When was the last time the world felt so 
close? When was the last time Japan 
yearned so deeply for the world?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just racing programs—day after 
day, the daytime talk shows were covering 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, too.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Public viewing tickets at movie theaters 
are already sold out at this point."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's said that on that day, tens of 
thousands of race fans head to racecourses 
across the nation to cheer them on—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is eagerly awaiting Japan's 
first historic achievement.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I will win here. Now, when everything 
has fallen into place—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...! Hey, Trainer <username>. I need to talk to you!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I want to add more training for <chrname>. ...Is 
that all right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Today's victory was splendid, but we 
can't let our guard down. Let's see it 
through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the tendencies of those who won 
the Prix Niel and went on to conquer the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, she still has 
some areas where she falls short.
choice_data_list: What kind of tendency might that be?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: You have not yet conquered a European GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, you will be fine. There have been 
Umamusume in the past who won despite not 
having won a European G1 race before the 
Prix Niel, just like you girls!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, every single one of them is an 
Umamusume who has trained in France from 
the start. That is why—
choice_data_list:
Once I get more used to the local terrain, 
being the best in the world will be within 
reach...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yes, which is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...! <chrname>! Do you agree as well?
I exchange looks with <chrname>. Her answer is—

That night's training session was attended 
not only by <chrname>, but by all the girls who had 
been selected as representatives.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I'm counting on you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Mei. Are you watching that 
interview again?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Because it sounds so cool! 'Building a 
bridge across the world'!"

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"Then why not just tell her yourself? 
You're already Speed Symboli's 
"companion," after all."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "...That's... Well, who cares, anyway?"

text_block_list.name: Grandfather Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Mei, could you translate this 
for me? An airmail letter arrived from 
France.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Mei. You should come along on the next 
overseas training trip too. I'll introduce 
you to the trainers over there.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Heheh, yours truly is as popular as 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: ...Right, Mei.

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
"You will surely witness it. The day we 
stand as equals with the world. The day 
Japan becomes the greatest in the world."

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to that day.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure everyone is waiting for a 
victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mei.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yayoi. The bridge to the world will be 
built soon.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The era where it's dismissed as a fairy 
tale is over, and everyone who dreams will 
be given a chance!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Our dream will surely come true.
